Description: Infection of susceptible individuals at force of infection λ(t) = β * I(t)/N
Progression through first exposed sub-compartment at rate σ
Progression from exposed to infectious at rate σ
Progression through first infectious sub-compartment at rate γ

Name: β
Description: Transmission rate, the rate at which new infections take place given a contact

Name: σ
Description: Daily rate of transition from E1 to E2 and from E2 to I1, leading to average incubation period dL = 2/σ days

Name: γ
Description: Daily rate of transition from I1 to I2 and from I2 to R, leading to average infectious period dI = 2/γ days

Name: π
Description: Proportion of the population who are initially susceptible

Name: ψ
Description: Exponential growth rate (EGR) at which compartments E1, E2, I1, and I2 grow initially

Name: pICU
Description: Probability of ICU/HDU admission given infection

Name: μICU|E
Description: Mean time from infection to ICU admission

Name: σ²ICU|E
Description: Variance of time from infection to ICU admission

Name: η
Description: Over-dispersion parameter of the Negative Binomial observation model

Name: δt
Description: Discrete time step length (quarter of a day)
